data.name: Fardeen
data.gender_notes: Fardeen is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fardeen is a Persian name meaning 'Lovable, Radiant'. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the name is associated with Lord Krishna, who was known for his enchanting charm and love for his devotees. The name carries the essence of compassion and charm, making it an ideal choice for a baby boy. The name Fardeen carries the meaning “Lovable, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Persian tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Fardeen usually hope their child will grow to embody lovable, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine love and charm of Lord Krishna.
data.etymology: Fardeen belongs to the Persian linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lovable, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fardeen total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
